hero.subtitle: I Build things for the server
hero.description: Systems Engineer | 2 years as backend developer | Learning cloud and DevOps

about.about1: I'm a backend developer with a passion for building efficient and scalable software. I have experience working with Java, Node.js and cloud technologies. I enjoy learning new technologies and improving my skills to create better solutions.
about.about2: In my last job, I had the opportunity to work on a project that involved migrating a monolithic application to a microservices architecture. This experience allowed me to gain valuable insights into the benefits and challenges of microservices, as well as how to design and implement them effectively.
about.about3: Nowadays, I'm focused on learning more about cloud computing and DevOps practices to enhance my skills and contribute to building robust and scalable applications.

tasks: Developing API using java, Quarkus framework, PostgreSQL and graphql
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define and design new features wiht agile methodologies
jobs.description: As a Backend Trainee at Joyit, I gained hands-on experience developing APIs using Java, Quarkus, PostgreSQL, and GraphQL, while learning best practices in backend development and writing clean, maintainable code in a production environment. I worked closely with cross-functional teams under agile methodologies, participating in planning, development, and iteration cycles, which helped me understand how technical solutions align with business needs. During this period, I also supported the migration from a monolithic architecture to microservices, strengthening my understanding of scalable systems, service decomposition, and modern backend architecture.

tasks: Lead the development of new features and services
Architecture Design like microservices, event-driven and serverless
CQRS, Saga Pattern, DDD and real time notifications
